    StartersBroccoli pizza squaresTray pizza with garlic oil, mozzarella and broccoliniHow to make it500g pizza dough2 tbsp olive oil, for the tray2 garlic cloves, crushed200g mozzarella, grated1 bunch broccolini, cut small30g parmesan, grated1 tsp chilli flakesPress the dough into an oiled tray and brush with the garlic oil.Top with mozzarella and broccolini.Bake at 240°C for 15 minutes until crisp at the edges.Finish with parmesan and chilli flakes.Core memory cheese ballsCheddar cream cheese balls rolled in paprika, parsley, sesame and pistachioHow to make it250g cream cheese150g cheddar, grated1 tbsp sweet paprika2 tbsp chopped parsley2 tbsp sesame seeds40g pistachios, crushed2 tbsp black sesame seedsBeat the cream cheese with the cheddar.Roll into small balls.Coat in five colours: paprika, parsley, sesame, pistachio and black sesame.Chill until firm.MainsFamily dinner lemon and rosemary chickenLemon and garlic rubbed chicken thighs roasted over small potatoesHow to make it8 chicken thighs, bone in1kg small potatoes, halved2 lemons4 garlic cloves, crushed2 tbsp chopped rosemary4 tbsp olive oil300g green beans30g buttersalt, to tasteHeat the oven to 220°C. Toss the potatoes in oil and salt on a large tray.Rub the chicken with lemon zest, garlic, rosemary, oil and salt and sit it skin side up on the potatoes.Roast for 35 to 40 minutes until the skin is crisp and the juices run clear. Squeeze over the lemon juice.Boil the beans for 3 minutes and toss with butter.Minnesota potato gem hotdishHome in Minnesota before the moveHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef mince, green beans and corn baked in a creamy mushroom sauce under rows of crisp golden potato gems, with a little cheddar melted over.Heat the oven to 200°C.Brown 600g beef mince with 1 diced onion.Make a sauce: soften 200g sliced mushrooms in 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 300ml milk and 200ml beef stock and simmer until thick.Stir the beef, 200g chopped green beans and 1 cup corn kernels into the sauce and pour into a baking dish.Cover with 700g frozen potato gems in rows and bake for 35 minutes, adding 100g grated cheddar for the last 5.SweetsFive feelings cupcakesVanilla cupcakes with buttercream in five coloursHow to make it275g butter, softened150g caster sugar2 eggs200g self-raising flour125ml milk300g icing sugar1 box food colouring in yellow, blue, red, purple and greenBeat part of the butter with the sugar, add the eggs and fold in the flour and milk.Bake in a muffin tin at 175°C for 18 minutes. Cool.Beat the rest of the butter with the icing sugar, split into five bowls and tint each a feeling colour with the food colouring.Pipe onto the cupcakes.Bing Bong pink fairy floss meringuesMeringues for Bing Bong: take her to the moon for me.How to make itAs written, serves 4Crisp pink strawberry meringue kisses with soft chewy middles, topped with a puff of fairy floss just before serving.Heat the oven to 110°C.Whisk 3 egg whites to soft peaks, then add 170g caster sugar a spoon at a time until thick and glossy.Fold in 1 tbsp freeze-dried strawberry powder and a drop of pink food colouring.Pipe 24 kisses onto lined trays and bake for 1 hour, then turn the oven off and leave them inside to cool for 1 hour.Top each with a little pink fairy floss right before serving.DrinksBing Bong's fairy floss milkshakeStrawberry vanilla ice cream shake topped with pink cotton candyHow to make it1 L vanilla ice cream500ml cold milk250g strawberries1 tub fairy flossBlend the ice cream with the milk and strawberries until thick.Pour into glasses and top each with a tuft of pink fairy floss just before serving so it starts to melt into the shake.Strawberry banana smoothieTriple Dent Gum jingle, still stuck.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
